findings.desc: packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:29 says Codex subagent prompts live in .Codex/agents, but packages/main/src/cli-init.ts:244 and docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md:126-147 both say thin asset mode uses the registry and may omit .Codex/agents. New init can therefore emit AGENTS.md text that misstates the generated asset shape in thin mode.
